# Three.js 0.180.0

Vendored browser modules for the optional packaging animation. MIT license is in `LICENSE`; copyright notices remain in both modules. Keeping this pinned copy here avoids a runtime dependency on a third-party CDN.

Upstream package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.180.0

Source downloads:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.core.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/LICENSE

These files are loaded only when the film starts, not by the editor itself. Update both modules together and retain the license.
